data.one_liner: A production-ready HTTP server framework for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Jaguar is an HTTP server framework for building backend services and APIs. It provides routing, path and query parameter parsing, request body decoding for JSON and forms, static file serving, and session management out of the box.
use_when: You need to build a custom HTTP server or REST API in Dart
You want easy out-of-the-box routing, query parameter casting, and session support
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application communicating with an API
You require complex microservice tooling not provided by basic HTTP servers
strengths: Built-in utilities for JSON, form parsing, sessions, and static files
Powerful route matching with path parameters and regex
